Strongest counterargument: Field Notes is the only evidenced creator channel, selection is competitive, applications open only in November 2026, and Kestrel's budget and terms are undisclosed. Contact: partnerships@kestrel.example.com is officially published, verified and on a business page, so policy readiness is ELIGIBLE_FOR_GATES.
